title: A US court dismisses Amazon's challenge to a 2025 CPSC order requiring it to recall 400K+ hazardous products sold by third parties via Fulfillment by Amazon (Emma Roth/The Verge)
summary: Emma Roth / The Verge: A US court dismisses Amazon's challenge to a 2025 CPSC order requiring it to recall 400K+ hazardous products sold by third parties via Fulfillment by Amazon — A court ruled in favor of the US CPSC's argument that Amazon is responsible for recalled products that other companies sell on its platforms.
